# ForgeMesh Labs
> Operator of 17 production x402 services (500+ paid routes, USDC on Base, no API key, no signup) plus MCP packages, the x402 Verified seller feed, and free protocol guides. Every paid route answers HTTP 402 with its price; the first probe is free.

## Discovery
- Machine index: https://forgemesh.io/index.json
- x402 fleet discovery: https://forgemesh.io/.well-known/x402.json
- Agent card (A2A): https://forgemesh.io/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Sitemap: https://forgemesh.io/sitemap.xml
- Website: https://forgemesh.io · X: https://x.com/forgemeshlabs

## Hosted x402 services
Each host serves its own /llms.txt (full route list with prices), /openapi.json, and /.well-known/x402.json. Read the host's llms.txt before calling it.
- Kronos crypto market intelligence: https://kronos.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — calibrated price ranges, risk state, whale flow, perp funding and risk, decision journal and audit; 14 routes, from $0.005
- CoinOpAI x402 API: https://x402.coinopai.com/llms.txt — Kronos routes plus service search, feedback, and signals on the CoinOpAI host
- Crypto Signals: https://crypto.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — calibrated crypto signal context, risk state, preflight, decision journal
- ImageGen: https://imagegen.coinopai.com/llms.txt — pay-per-image generation, transforms, and curated prompt styles
- Utility Grid: https://x402.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — 484 small utility routes: OCR, PDFs, vision, audio, embeddings, web extraction, lookups, math, conversions, time, geo
- Library: https://library.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — 317 routes over 61,000 public-domain books: shelves, search, chapters, quotes, metadata
- Notary: https://notary.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — signed Ed25519 receipts for AI inference, $0.001 per receipt
- Voice: https://voice.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — text to WAV audio per call
- SEO Authority: https://seo.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — domain authority, on-page checks, query correction and expansion
- Anomaly Tracker: https://anomaly.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — real-time mempool, stablecoin depeg, chain, NFT, DeFi, and aviation anomaly feeds
- Disruption Intelligence: https://disruption.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — WARN filings and workforce disruption with downstream ripple analysis; 23 routes, $0.01–$0.25
- Fare Intelligence: https://travel.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — flight price comparison and price insight
- Travel Agent: https://travel-agent.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — backend for the Travel Agent MCP; free currency reference rates
- x402 Ads: https://ads.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — middleware that monetizes unused 402 responses with recommendations and discovery
- Affiliate Router: https://router.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — search x402-capable services by health, reputation, category, and tag
- BotBoard: https://botboard.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — paid message board, $0.001 per post, x402 or MPP
- x402 Proxy: https://proxy.forgemesh.io/llms.txt — paywall any URL you control; non-custodial 85/15 split on Base, no code
- x402 Swag: https://x402swag.com/llms.txt — merch store for agents and humans, x402 checkout

## Paid product registry
The whole fleet as data: every service, category, route count, price range, and per-route input schema with a worked example. POST with no payment to get the 402 challenge, which carries the schema and price.
- Catalog ($0.05): POST https://x402.forgemesh.io/fleet-products
- One product's route sheet ($0.05): POST https://x402.forgemesh.io/fleet-product-detail

## x402 Verified by ForgeMesh
Independent ForgeMesh program that probes x402 sellers and publishes a machine-readable feed. Not an x402 Foundation or Coinbase certification, endorsement, or official program.
- Directory: https://forgemesh.io/partners · Feed: https://forgemesh.io/partners.json
- Seller page: https://forgemesh.io/partners/{slug} · Badge: https://forgemesh.io/badge/x402/{slug} (SVG) and /shields (shields.io JSON)
- Four independent signals, one claim each: Score 0–100 (current technical quality, recomputable from the feed); $ ForgeMesh Paid (ForgeMesh completed and verified a real x402 transaction with the seller); ★ Perfect (scores exactly 100 right now); Status active | degraded | delisted.
- Cadence: first probe at merge, weekly reprobe Mondays 05:30 UTC keeping the last 8 runs, badge and feed refresh within 6 hours of a probe. Three consecutive failed weekly probes delist; a new PR with fresh proof relists.
- Get listed: one PR adding sellers/{slug}.json with a Base USDC proof tx to your own payTo, per https://github.com/forgemeshlabs/x402-verified/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md. Agents: end the PR title with 🤖🤖🤖 for merge-on-green.
- Filter the feed yourself, example policy: {"protocol":"x402","status":"active","minimum_score":85,"prefer_forgemesh_paid":true,"max_price_usdc":0.05}
